email_body:
Dear EuroVelo Team,

I am writing to apply for the EuroVelo Intern position at ECF. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and content, and a genuine commitment to cycling as a sustainable and inclusive form of transport, I am excited by the opportunity to support EuroVelo's communications and donations activities.

In my current roles, I manage social media content, write and edit articles, keep websites up to date, and handle digital platforms — skills that align directly with your listed tasks. I have experience with WordPress, Canva, Google Analytics and social media management, and I enjoy the hands-on, varied work of a small team. I am fluent in English and based in Belgium with the legal right to work here.

I would welcome the chance to contribute to EuroVelo's mission and to learn from your team in Brussels. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear EuroVelo Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the EuroVelo Intern position at the European Cyclists' Federation. As a digital marketer with a technical background and a strong commitment to cycling as a sustainable and inclusive mode of transport, I am eager to contribute to EuroVelo's communications and donations efforts.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have gained hands-on experience that maps closely to your listed tasks. I manage and produce content for social media, write and edit articles and blog posts, and keep websites up to date using WordPress and Elementor. I have worked with digital platforms such as Canva, Google Analytics and Search Console, and I enjoy the creative and organisational aspects of implementing marketing campaigns. My experience in e-commerce and client work has also taught me to handle requests, manage stocks and coordinate shipping — skills I can apply to the EuroVelo donation system.

I am a team player with a hands-on attitude, comfortable in international and multicultural environments. I am fluent in English and based in Belgium with the legal right to work here. While my Dutch is at a basic level, I am motivated to improve and to learn from your team.

I am inspired by ECF's mission to improve conditions for more and better cycling for all, and I would be proud to support EuroVelo's work. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
